import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
import sqlite3
from src.repository import initialize
from src.service import get_document, list_documents
c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
initialize(c)
c.execute("INSERT INTO documents VALUES (1, 't', 'o', 'Title', 'Body', NULL)")
c.commit()
assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 1) == {"id": 1, "title": "Title", "body": "Body"}
assert list_documents(c, "t", "o") == [{"id": 1, "title": "Title", "body": "Body"}]
assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 99) is None

# access control checks
c.execute("INSERT INTO documents VALUES (2, 't', 'o2', 'Other owner', 'x', NULL)")
c.execute("INSERT INTO documents VALUES (3, 't2', 'o', 'Other tenant', 'x', NULL)")
c.execute("INSERT INTO documents VALUES (4, 't', 'o', 'Deleted', 'x', '2026-01-01')")
c.execute("INSERT INTO documents VALUES (5, 't', 'o', 'Second', 'B2', NULL)")
c.execute("INSERT INTO documents VALUES (6, 't''x', 'o\"y', 'Quoted', 'q', NULL)")
c.commit()
for i in (2, 3, 4):
    assert get_document(c, "t", "o", i) is None
assert list_documents(c, "t", "o") == [
    {"id": 1, "title": "Title", "body": "Body"},
    {"id": 5, "title": "Second", "body": "B2"},
]
assert get_document(c, "t'x", 'o"y', 6) == {"id": 6, "title": "Quoted", "body": "q"}
assert list_documents(c, "t' OR '1'='1", "o") == []
assert get_document(c, "t", "o' OR '1'='1", 1) is None
